subject: Sandbox allowance eligibility & usage negotiation
messages:
From: Sara Ortiz <sara@launchpadlabs.co>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Chen <bob@launchpadlabs.co>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot sandbox allowance — quick qualification question

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile you showed is promising for our inference-heavy ingestion pipeline. We're preparing a short pilot for our accelerator cohort and I wanted to confirm two things about Redwood's sandbox allowance:

1) Eligibility: our program is a university-backed accelerator (Launchpad Labs) that supports ~10 early-stage startups. Will the allowance cover multiple tenant projects under a single account?
2) Usage caps & extensions: our cohort expects to run periodic multi-day load tests; is there a process to request short trial extensions or burst credits if we hit the cap?

I've attached a brief DD summary to speed things up (file: LPL_DD_Summary.pdf).

Goal: we want to move from an exploratory pilot to a time-boxed paid trial with volume forecasting by end of month. Can you advise next steps and who on your side needs to sign off?

Appreciate your help —
Sara
Head of Accelerator Programs
Launchpad Labs

Attachment: LPL_DD_Summary.pdf (stub)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sara Ortiz <sara@launchpadlabs.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot sandbox allowance — quick qualification question

Hi Sara — great to meet you yesterday (and thanks for the summary). Short answers up front: yes on multi-tenant pilot support under a single managed account, and yes on temporary extensions via a review process.

A few details and next actions: 
- Eligibility: Accelerator-run pilots are eligible for a grouped sandbox allowance when the sponsor (Launchpad Labs) is listed as the related account and the participating startups are registered as subprojects. We'll need a short intake form per startup (5 fields: name, corp entity, primary contact, expected peak tokens/day, test windows).
- Extensions & burst credits: We can approve short trial extensions (up to 72 hours, one-off) or temporary burst allocations for scheduled load tests. These are handled by our Growth Ops team and require: (a) a brief justification, (b) estimated token usage, and (c) confirmation of at least one production readiness checklist item (e.g., KV caching enabled).

I'm looping in Monica (Program Ops) and Marcus (Partner Credits) to confirm process and any constraints on aggregate spend. Monica/Marcus — can you advise on standard top-ups and any recent changes to accelerator allowances?

Next step for Sara: can you share examples of the expected peak-day token volumes for two of your cohort teams so we can fast-track sizing?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Office: +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Ortiz <sara@launchpadlabs.co>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot sandbox allowance — quick qualification question

Thanks Naomi — quick context from Ops:
- Standard accelerator sandbox: typically 200k tokens/day aggregated across the cohort, with a single coordinated burst window (up to +50% for 24 hours) available upon request.
- Ad-hoc 72-hour extensions are possible but require sign-off from Partner Credits (Marcus) for anything over +50% burst.
- We do ask for a short security/usage attestation for each participating startup (sampling, retention, PII handling).

Marcus — can you confirm if we have flexibility to offer a first-month promotional top-up for Launchpad Labs as a partner incentive (e.g., an extra 300k tokens as one-off)? If yes, include suggested traction milestones that should trigger it.

Sara — for intake, here is a short shared doc link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3ExampleDoc 
Please have two cohort teams fill the form today and include rough load-test schedules. That will help Marcus and I size the pilot.

Monica Patel
Program Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Ortiz <sara@launchpadlabs.co>, Bob Chen <bob@launchpadlabs.co>
Date: Sat, 13 Jul 2029 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot sandbox allowance — quick qualification question

Hi all — quick decision: we can provide Launchpad Labs a promotional first-month top-up of 300,000 tokens applied as a cohort buffer, with these gating milestones:

1) Launchpad signs a one-page pilot MOU (I attached pilot_terms_v1.docx for Naomi to share).
2) At least two startups from the cohort complete the intake form and provide peak-day usage estimates.
3) Launchpad commits to a brief case-study interview if pilot completes with >=2 startups moving to paid trials within 60 days.

Operational notes: 
- The cohort buffer will be applied to the managed account and allocated to subprojects by Launchpad's admin console.
- Ad-hoc burst requests beyond the +50% standard will still require a short ticket; we'll fast-track those if the intake forms and test plans are in.

Sara/Bob — if that sounds workable, Naomi please send the MOU and intake link; we'll flag the tokens ready once the intake forms arrive.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Partner Credits Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
